title: 第1206章 脱胎换骨第1205章 心幻草
content_zh:
易长生还注意到，那些城池之间的道路上偶尔会有一些车队在移动。
那些车队由几匹模样奇特的驮兽拉着，驮兽体型大约与下界的马匹相当，但四肢更粗短、身躯更宽厚，背上的驮架上堆满了各种货物。
车队的前后都有修士护卫，那些护卫的修为大多在筑基或是丹期之间，他们会在出发前服用某种特制的丹药，并在脸上佩戴一种覆盖住口鼻的银白色面罩。
那些面罩的表面流转着微弱的灵光，显然是某种专门用来过滤心幻草花粉和种子的防护法器。
车队在行进时保持着严密的队形，护卫们的神识持续向四周扩散，警惕着任何可能从草丛中扑出的妖兽。
有一次，易长生甚至远远地看到了一支车队正停靠在路边休整，队伍中一个看上去大约只有筑基期修为的年轻修士从驮兽背上跳下来，跑到路边的草丛边蹲下去似乎在查看什么东西。
他刚一靠近那丛心幻草，身体就忽然僵住了，然后整个人如同被抽走了所有力气一般软倒在地上，眼神涣散、嘴角流出涎水，显然是中了心幻草的致幻效果。
护卫们似乎对此习以为常，其中一人不紧不慢地走过去，从怀中取出一只玉瓶，倒出一粒褐色的药丸塞入那年轻修士的口中，然后拍了拍他的脸颊等他恢复意识。
整个过程像是处理一件每天都在发生的日常小事，没有人惊慌，没有人加快动作，甚至有人还在不远处悠闲地喝着水囊中的水。
易长生远远地看着这一幕，心中更加坚定了自己此刻的判断，在灵界这片广阔而复杂的大地上，每一寸土地都有它自己的规则和危险。
不了解规则就贸然闯入某个陌生区域的下场，或许就是那个年轻修士的样子。
在毫无预兆地倒在一片看似无害的草丛边，连自己是怎么中招的都不知道。
他收回目光，将注意力重新锁定在前方四位化神修士的遁光上。
四人依然保持着稳定的速度和一致的编队，正朝着南方那片逐渐清晰起来的、心幻草越来越稀疏的平原边缘继续推进。
太阳在灵界的天空中缓缓划出一道弧线，从正午的明亮炽白逐渐转向下午的暖黄，最后在西方的地平线处沉入一片被晚霞染成紫红色的云海中。
天光从明亮到昏沉再到黑暗，星辰从稀疏到密集，月亮从东方的地平线上升起，将银灰色的光辉洒满整片心幻平原的广阔大地。
易长生在这片月光中无声地飞行着，保持着他的跟随距离，将虚维之眼的视角稳定地锁定在前方四人的轨迹上，跟着那四道遁光划过灵界的夜空，一点一点地向南方推进。
每一天的飞行都是相似的，但每一天他都能从这相似中发现新的细节、学到新的东西。
灵界的风、灵界的灵气、灵界的土壤和草木、灵界的星辰和月色，都在他的感知中一点一点地变得熟悉起来，从最初那种全然陌生的震撼感，逐渐转化为一种如同认识一个新朋友般的亲近和理解。
易长生在灵界已经存在了十几天。

时间不长，但足以让他开始在这个辽阔而陌生的世界中找到自己的节奏和方位感。
那些最初几日因跨界而来的轻微眩晕、因灵气浓度剧烈变化而导致经脉的持续胀满感、因昼夜节律与下界不同而产生的生物钟错位，都在这些天的持续飞行和适应中逐渐消退。
他的身体已经习惯了灵界空气中那种更高密度的灵气在每一次呼吸中涌入肺腑的感觉。
习惯了灵界重力将他的骨骼和肌肉微微拉向地面的那种厚重感，习惯了星辰在夜空中那异常明亮而稳定的光芒穿透视网膜时的微妙灼热感。
他的经脉在灵界灵气的持续润养下变得更加通畅和饱满，每一次灵气的循环流转都比在下界时更加圆润流畅，丹田中那团元婴之力也在这十几天的浸润中变得更加凝实，如同被反复锤炼过的铁胚在淬火后逐渐成型。
他甚至开始能够分辨出灵界空气中那些细微的层次差异，清晨时分的灵气带着一种如同露水般清冽的凉意。
正午时分的灵气则如同被阳光晒暖了的温泉水般浑厚温热，而夜晚的灵气又带着一种深沉如古井般的、带着泥土和草木根系气息的醇厚质感。
这种层次感是他在下界时从来没有感受过的，下界的灵气稀薄而单一，如同一杯兑了太多水的淡茶，无论什么时候喝都是一个味道。
而灵界的灵气则像一坛陈年佳酿，在不同的时辰、不同的温度、不同的风向下，会呈现出完全不同的风味和质地。
最重要的是，经过这么多天的转换，易长生觉得仿佛脱胎换骨一般，甚至觉得梦身的寿元都增加了不少。
到了离开归元洞天出口的第十四天。
地面上的地形终于开始慢慢地发生了变化。
最初的变化是极其细微的，细微到如果不是他一直保持着对周围环境的高度关注，甚至可能会忽略掉。
那是一片在平原边缘出现的、稀稀落落的小片树林，每片树林的面积不大，大约只有一两里见方。
树种是他在心幻平原上从未见过的一种叶片呈银灰色的乔木，树干笔直，树皮光滑如镜面，在午后的阳光下反射出一片片如同碎银般的闪烁光点。
那些小树林的数量从最初的一两片逐渐增多到十几片、几十片，分散在平原的地平线上，像是有人在大地上随意撒下了一把银色的碎屑。
紧接着，平原上那覆盖了整整十几天行程的、几乎无处不在的心幻草开始变得稀疏起来。
那一丛丛淡紫色的茎秆和粉白色的花序不再是整片整片地铺满地面，而是变成了一块一块的斑块状分布，中间开始露出大片裸土和低矮的绿色野草。
空气中那股令人心神微荡的甜香气息也随之变得稀薄，从浓烈变得清淡，从清淡变得若有若无，最终彻底消散在越来越频繁的林间微风之中。
易长生深深地吸了一口没有心幻草香气掺杂的空气，只觉那气息清冽通透得如同一口冰泉灌入肺腑，将他心中残余的那一丝不易察觉的微醺感彻底洗去。

然后山脉出现了。
content_en:
Yi Changsheng also noticed that there were occasionally some convoys moving on the roads between the cities.
Those convoys were pulled by several strange-looking beasts of burden. The beasts were about the same size as horses in the lower world, but had stubbier limbs and a wider body. The packhorses on their backs were piled with various goods.
There are monk guards at the front and rear of the motorcade. Most of these guards are at the foundation building or elixir stage. They will take some kind of special elixir before setting off, and wear a silver-white mask on their face that covers their mouth and nose.
There was a faint spiritual light flowing on the surface of those masks, and they were obviously some kind of protective magic weapon specially used to filter the pollen and seeds of the Heart Fantasy Grass.
The convoy maintained a tight formation as it marched, and the guards' consciousness continued to spread around, wary of any monsters that might pounce out of the grass.
Once, Yi Changsheng even saw a motorcade stopping at the roadside for a rest. A young monk in the team who seemed to be only in the foundation-building stage jumped off the back of the beast and ran to the grass on the roadside and squatted down as if to check something.
As soon as he got close to the clump of Heart Fantasy Grass, his body suddenly froze, and then he fell softly to the ground as if all his strength had been drained away. His eyes were blurred and saliva flowed from the corners of his mouth. He was obviously suffering from the hallucinogenic effect of the Heart Fantasy Grass.
The guards seemed accustomed to this. One of them walked over slowly, took out a jade bottle from his arms, poured out a brown pill and stuffed it into the young monk's mouth, then patted his cheek and waited for him to regain consciousness.
The whole process was like dealing with a small daily thing that happened every day. No one panicked, no one moved faster, and some people were even leisurely drinking water from the water bag not far away.
Yi Changsheng watched this scene from a distance, and his judgment at this moment became more firm in his heart. In the vast and complex land of the spiritual world, every inch of land has its own rules and dangers.
The consequences of rushing into an unfamiliar area without knowing the rules may be the same as that of the young monk.
He fell down beside a seemingly harmless patch of grass without warning, not even knowing how he was hit.
He withdrew his gaze and refocused his attention on the escaping light of the four god-transformation monks in front of him.
The four of them still maintained a stable speed and consistent formation, and continued to advance towards the edge of the plain in the south where the Heart Fantasy Grass became increasingly sparse and became increasingly clear.
The sun slowly draws an arc in the sky of the spiritual world, gradually turning from bright white at noon to warm yellow in the afternoon, and finally sinks into a sea of ​​clouds dyed purple-red by the sunset at the western horizon.
The sky light changes from bright to dim to dark, the stars change from sparse to dense, and the moon rises from the eastern horizon, spreading its silver-gray brilliance over the vast land of the fantasy plain.
Yi Changsheng flew silently in the moonlight, maintaining his following distance, locking the perspective of the Eye of Virtual Reality steadily on the trajectory of the four people in front, and followed the four escaping lights across the night sky of the spiritual world, advancing bit by bit to the south.
Every day's flight is similar, but every day he can discover new details and learn new things from the similarities.
The wind in the spiritual world, the spiritual energy in the spiritual world, the soil and vegetation in the spiritual world, the stars and moonlight in the spiritual world all became familiar to him little by little. From the initial shock of being completely unfamiliar, it gradually transformed into a kind of closeness and understanding like meeting a new friend.
Yi Changsheng has existed in the spirit world for more than ten days.
It wasn't long, but it was long enough for him to begin to find his own rhythm and sense of direction in this vast and unfamiliar world.
The slight dizziness caused by crossing the realm in the first few days, the constant fullness of the meridians caused by the drastic changes in spiritual energy concentration, and the misalignment of the biological clock caused by the difference between the circadian rhythm and the lower realm, all gradually subsided in these days of continuous flight and adaptation.
His body hasI am used to the feeling of the higher density spiritual energy in the spirit world flowing into my lungs with every breath.
He is used to the heavy feeling of the gravity of the spiritual world pulling his bones and muscles slightly towards the ground, and is used to the subtle burning feeling when the unusually bright and stable light of the stars in the night sky penetrates the retina.
His meridians have become smoother and fuller under the continuous nourishment of spiritual energy from the spiritual world. Each circulation of spiritual energy is more rounded and smooth than in the lower world. The power of the Nascent Soul in the Dantian has also become more solid after being infiltrated for more than ten days, like an iron embryo that has been repeatedly tempered and gradually formed after quenching.
He even began to be able to distinguish the subtle differences in the air in the spiritual world. The spiritual energy in the early morning had a coolness as clear as dew.
The aura at noon is as thick and warm as hot spring water warmed by the sun, while the aura at night has a mellow texture as deep as an ancient well, with the smell of earth and roots.
This sense of layering was something he had never experienced when he was in the lower realm. The spiritual energy in the lower realm was thin and single, like a cup of weak tea mixed with too much water. It always had the same taste no matter when you drank it.
The spiritual energy in the spiritual world is like a jar of aged wine. It will show completely different flavors and textures at different times, temperatures, and winds.
The most important thing is that after so many days of transformation, Yi Changsheng felt as if he had been reborn, and even felt that Mengshen's lifespan had increased a lot.
It was the fourteenth day after leaving the exit of Guiyuan Cave.
The terrain on the ground finally began to slowly change.
The initial changes were extremely subtle, so subtle that he might have even ignored them if he hadn't been paying close attention to his surroundings.
It was a small, sparse forest that appeared on the edge of the plain. Each forest was small in area, only about one or two miles square.
The tree species was a tree with silver-gray leaves that he had never seen before on the Fantasy Plain. The trunk was straight and the bark was as smooth as a mirror. In the afternoon sun, it reflected shimmering spots like broken silver.
The number of those small woods gradually increased from one or two at the beginning to more than a dozen or dozens, scattered on the horizon of the plain, as if someone had randomly scattered a handful of silvery debris on the ground.
Immediately afterwards, the almost ubiquitous fantasy grass on the plain that covered the entire ten-day journey began to become sparse.
The clumps of lavender stems and pink-white inflorescences no longer covered the ground entirely, but became distributed in patches, with large areas of bare soil and low green weeds beginning to appear in the middle.
The mind-blowing sweet scent in the air also became thinner, from strong to light, from light to vague, and finally completely dissipated in the increasingly frequent forest breeze.
Yi Changsheng took a deep breath of the air that was not mixed with the fragrance of the Heart Fantasy Grass. He felt that the air was as clear and transparent as an icy spring pouring into his lungs, completely washing away the remaining unnoticeable feeling of tipsiness in his heart.
Then the mountains appeared.
